blocks.zh: 第七章：建築設計
blocks.en: Chapter 7: Architectural Design

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解生物製藥廠房「由內而外」的建築設計原則，以及三個設計階段（概念、基本、詳細）的意涵
blocks.en: Understand the "inside-out" architectural design principle for biopharmaceutical facilities and the meaning of the three design stages (conceptual, basic, detailed)

blocks.zh: 掌握廠房功能概念：垂直/水平流程、模組化建設（Off-Site Construction）、廠區流動管理（人員、物料、廢棄物）
blocks.en: Grasp the facility concepts: vertical/horizontal flow, modular (off-site) construction, and site flow management (personnel, materials, waste)

blocks.zh: 學習廠址選擇（Masterplanning）的關鍵考量：氣候、生物安全、現有設施改建限制（Brownfield vs Greenfield）
blocks.en: Learn the key considerations in site selection (masterplanning): climate, biosecurity, and the constraints of converting existing facilities (brownfield vs greenfield)

blocks.zh: 了解建築外殼（Building Envelope）設計、模組化設計（Modular Design）對廠房長期投資回報的影響
blocks.en: Understand how building envelope design and modular design affect the long-term return on a facility investment

blocks.zh: 掌握結構設計要點：樓板荷重、跨距、抗震設計、以及對未來廠房彈性的影響
blocks.en: Grasp the key points of structural design: floor loading, spans, seismic design, and their effect on future facility flexibility

blocks.zh: 認識建築資訊模型 BIM（Building Information Modeling）在生物製藥廠房設計管理中的應用
blocks.en: Become familiar with the application of BIM (Building Information Modeling) in the design management of biopharmaceutical facilities

blocks.zh: 7.1 Introduction — 導論
blocks.en: 7.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 由內而外設計（Inside-Out Design）：生物製藥廠房的設計順序是先確定製程需求（設備、流程、清潔分級），再由此向外推演建築結構。這與一般商業建築「先蓋好外殼再想怎麼用」完全相反。
blocks.en: Inside-Out Design: The design of a biopharmaceutical facility starts by fixing the process requirements (equipment, flows, cleanliness classification) and then works outward to the building structure. This is the opposite of ordinary commercial buildings, where the shell is built first and the use is worked out afterwards.

blocks.zh: 三個設計階段：
blocks.en: The three design stages:

blocks.zh: 概念設計（Conceptual）：確定廠房類型、規模、整體布局方向。此階段是最重要的，因為此後的決策成本代價最高。
blocks.en: Conceptual: Determines the facility type, scale and overall layout direction. This is the most important stage, because decisions made after it are the most costly to change.

blocks.zh: 基本設計（Basic）：確定具體尺寸、結構系統、主要設備位置。
blocks.en: Basic: Determines specific dimensions, the structural system and the locations of major equipment.

blocks.zh: 詳細設計（Detailed）：完成所有施工圖紙和規格說明。
blocks.en: Detailed: Completes all construction drawings and specifications.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 「由內而外設計」就像裁縫做衣服：先量身材（製程需求），再剪布料（建築設計）。反過來「先有建築再硬塞製程」就像買了一件現成西裝，卻發現袖子太短——改起來非常麻煩且昂貴。
blocks.en: Inside-out design is like a tailor making a suit: first take the measurements (process requirements), then cut the cloth (architectural design). Doing it the other way round, building first and forcing the process in afterwards, is like buying an off-the-rack suit and finding the sleeves too short: altering it is troublesome and expensive.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 每個設計階段都應執行風險與安全評估。生物製藥廠房在概念設計階段就必須考慮生物安全（Biosafety）分級需求，因為這直接影響通風系統、廢水處理、以及建築外殼設計。越晚發現問題，修改代價越高。
blocks.en: A risk and safety assessment should be performed at every design stage. For a biopharmaceutical facility, biosafety classification requirements must already be considered at the conceptual stage, because they directly affect the ventilation system, effluent treatment and the building envelope. The later a problem is found, the more it costs to correct.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為何生物製藥廠房的設計必須「由內而外」？若反過來「由外而內」，會造成哪些具體問題？
blocks.en: Why must the design of a biopharmaceutical facility be "inside-out"? What specific problems would arise if it were done "outside-in"?

blocks.zh: 技術轉移（Technical Transfer）時，哪些製程資訊對建築設計影響最大？請舉例說明。
blocks.en: During technical transfer, which process information has the greatest impact on architectural design? Please give examples.

blocks.zh: 7.2 Facility Design — 廠房設計
blocks.en: 7.2 Facility Design

blocks.zh: 廠房設計的全面整合：一座完整的生物製藥廠房不僅有生產區，還必須整合行政、品保、品管實驗室、倉儲（含冷鏈）、下游充填完成、以及公用設施。這些區域的相對位置和動線規劃，直接影響日常運作效率和GMP合規性。
blocks.en: Full integration of facility design: A complete biopharmaceutical facility has more than a production area. It must also integrate administration, QA, QC laboratories, warehousing (including cold chain), downstream fill-finish, and utilities. The relative positions of these areas and the planning of the flows between them directly affect daily operating efficiency and GMP compliance.

blocks.zh: 三個關鍵設計屬性：
blocks.en: Three key design attributes:

blocks.zh: 適應性（Adaptability）：廠房能否調整以應對製程變化
blocks.en: Adaptability: whether the facility can be adjusted to accommodate process changes

blocks.zh: 彈性（Flexibility）：廠房能否支援多品項或多製程
blocks.en: Flexibility: whether the facility can support multiple products or multiple processes

blocks.zh: 可擴展性（Expandability）：廠房能否在未來增加產能
blocks.en: Expandability: whether the facility can increase capacity in the future

blocks.zh: 對於CDMO而言，「彈性」特別重要——因為CDMO需要同時服務多個客戶、多種產品。廠房設計必須在初期就規劃好如何實現多品項切換，而不是事後亡羊補牢。品管實驗室（QC）的位置應靠近生產區，以縮短IPC樣品傳遞時間，提升生產效率。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, flexibility is especially important, because a CDMO serves multiple clients and multiple products at the same time. The facility design must plan from the outset how product changeover will be achieved, rather than trying to fix it after the event. The QC laboratory should be located close to the production area to shorten the transfer time of IPC samples and improve production efficiency.

blocks.zh: 在CDMO廠房設計中，「彈性」和「效率」有時會產生矛盾。您會如何在設計層面取得平衡？
blocks.en: In CDMO facility design, "flexibility" and "efficiency" sometimes conflict. How would you balance them at the design level?

blocks.zh: 冷鏈倉儲（Cold Chain）在建築設計上需要哪些特殊考量？
blocks.en: What special considerations does cold chain storage require in architectural design?

blocks.zh: 7.2.1 Key Drivers for a Fully Functional Production Facility and Campus — 功能性生產廠房的關鍵驅動因素
blocks.en: 7.2.1 Key Drivers for a Fully Functional Production Facility and Campus

blocks.zh: 三大設計驅動因素：
blocks.en: Three major design drivers:

blocks.zh: 1. 功能導向風險評估：從概念階段就開始做設計風險評估，並在整個設計和施工過程中持續更新。這是ISPE對「Quality by Design（QbD）」理念在建築設計層面的體現。
blocks.en: 1. Function-driven risk assessment: Design risk assessment starts at the concept stage and is continuously updated throughout design and construction. This is how ISPE expresses the Quality by Design (QbD) philosophy at the level of architectural design.

blocks.zh: 2. 運作經濟性與效率：物料從收貨到使用點的流程應儘量簡單直接，避免交叉流動（Cross-Flow），這對GMP合規和日常操作效率都至關重要。
blocks.en: 2. Operating economics and efficiency: The path of materials from receipt to point of use should be as simple and direct as possible, avoiding cross-flow. This is critical for both GMP compliance and daily operating efficiency.

blocks.zh: 3. 工作環境品質：明亮、安全、視野開闊的工作環境可以提高員工士氣和警覺性，也有助於管理層進行目視管理（Visual Management）。
blocks.en: 3. Quality of the working environment: A bright, safe, open working environment raises staff morale and alertness, and also helps management carry out visual management.

blocks.zh: 「避免交叉工作流程」就像超市的單向動線設計——購物車只走一個方向，收銀台在出口附近，不會讓顧客在走道中對撞。生物製藥廠房的物料流、人員流、廢棄物流也需要類似的「單向化」規劃，減少GMP風險。
blocks.en: Avoiding cross-flow of work is like the one-way aisle layout of a supermarket: trolleys travel in one direction and the checkouts are near the exit, so customers do not collide in the aisles. The material, personnel and waste flows of a biopharmaceutical facility need similar one-way planning to reduce GMP risk.

blocks.zh: 「保持行政和訪客停車在安全邊界外」這個看似簡單的要求，其實涉及廠房安全設計的核心：未授權人員不應接觸生產區。CDMO廠房還需要特別考慮客戶訪問（Client Visit）路線的設計，既要讓客戶能夠看到生產情況，又不能違反GMP動線規定。
blocks.en: The requirement to "keep administrative and visitor parking outside the secure perimeter" looks simple, but it goes to the heart of facility security design: unauthorized persons should not have access to the production area. A CDMO facility also needs special thought for client visit routes, which must let clients see production without breaching GMP flow rules.

blocks.zh: 在廠房設計中，「透明度（視覺連結）」與「清潔區域隔離」之間如何取得平衡？
blocks.en: How can "transparency (visual connection)" be balanced against segregation of clean areas in facility design?

blocks.zh: CDMO接待客戶參觀時，訪客動線應如何規劃才能同時滿足GMP要求和客戶體驗？
blocks.en: When a CDMO hosts client tours, how should the visitor route be planned to satisfy both GMP requirements and the client experience?

blocks.zh: 7.2.2 Facility Concepts — 廠房概念設計
blocks.en: 7.2.2 Facility Concepts

blocks.zh: 垂直 vs 水平流程（Vertical vs Horizontal Flow）：
blocks.en: Vertical vs horizontal flow:

blocks.zh: 生物製藥製程有時需要利用重力進行物料傳遞（例如：培養基從高樓層配製後重力流入下層生物反應槽），這就形成「垂直流程」。設計師必須在廠房高度和樓層規劃上提前預留空間。水平流程則較常見於小分子藥廠，物料在同一樓層平移。
blocks.en: Biopharmaceutical processes sometimes use gravity to transfer materials (for example, media prepared on an upper floor flows by gravity into bioreactors below), which creates a "vertical flow". Designers must reserve the space in building height and floor planning at an early stage. Horizontal flow, in which materials move across the same floor, is more common in small-molecule plants.

blocks.zh: 模組化建設（Off-Site Construction / Modular Construction）：在工廠預製模組，再運到現場組裝。相對於傳統現場施工（Stick-Build），具有品質更穩定、工期更短、可重複利用等優點。
blocks.en: Off-site construction / modular construction: Modules are prefabricated in a factory and then transported to site for assembly. Compared with traditional on-site stick-build construction, this offers more consistent quality, a shorter schedule and reusability.

blocks.zh: 模組化廠房（Modular Facility）就像積木式玩具（LEGO）——每塊積木在工廠精確製造，到現場只需組合。傳統現場施工則像用水泥砌牆，需要等待硬化、受天氣影響，且建好後很難改變。CDMO擴廠時，模組化設計可以直接「加裝積木」，省去大量時間和成本。
blocks.en: A modular facility is like LEGO: each brick is made precisely in the factory and only has to be assembled on site. Traditional stick-build construction is like building a wall in concrete: you wait for it to cure, you are at the mercy of the weather, and once built it is hard to change. When a CDMO expands, a modular design lets it simply "add more bricks", saving a great deal of time and cost.

blocks.zh: 生物製藥廠房有一個獨特挑戰：大型生物反應槽（Bioreactor）可能高達數層樓，廠房需要為此設計高天花板（可能需要4-6公尺淨高）。這是與一般小分子藥廠截然不同的建築需求。設計團隊必須在早期就確認最大設備尺寸，否則後期改動代價極高。
blocks.en: Biopharmaceutical facilities have a unique challenge: a large bioreactor can be several stories tall, so the building needs high ceilings (possibly 4-6 m clear height). This is a very different architectural requirement from a small-molecule plant. The design team must confirm the largest equipment dimensions early, otherwise late changes are extremely costly.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 台灣某CDMO正計劃建設新的生物製藥廠房，預算有限且工期緊迫。採用模組化建設（Off-Site Construction）有以下優勢：在台灣天氣多變的環境下，工廠預製可確保品質穩定；模組可預先通過驗證；未來若獲得新客戶，可快速增加模組擴大產能。缺點是前期設計決策必須非常明確，因為模組尺寸一旦固定就難以更改。
blocks.en: A CDMO in Taiwan plans to build a new biopharmaceutical facility with a limited budget and a tight schedule. Off-site construction offers these advantages: in Taiwan's changeable weather, factory prefabrication ensures consistent quality; modules can be qualified in advance; and if new clients are won in future, modules can be added quickly to expand capacity. The drawback is that early design decisions must be very firm, because once module dimensions are fixed they are hard to change.

blocks.zh: 模組化建設相比傳統現場施工（Stick-Build），在GMP驗證方面有哪些優劣勢？
blocks.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of modular construction compared with stick-build, from a GMP validation perspective?

blocks.zh: 如果您是CDMO的工程負責人，您會在哪些情況下選擇垂直流程設計？哪些情況下選擇水平流程？
blocks.en: If you were the engineering lead at a CDMO, in which situations would you choose a vertical flow design, and in which a horizontal flow design?

blocks.zh: 7.2.3 Flows and their Impact — 流動管理及其影響
blocks.en: 7.2.3 Flows and their Impact

blocks.zh: 廠內流動管理（In-Facility Flow Management）：GMP法規要求對廠內的人員、物料、廢棄物、樣品流動進行嚴格管控，防止交叉污染（Cross-Contamination）。這不只是操作程序問題，更是建築設計問題——廠房的通道、門的位置、換衣室的配置都必須支持正確的流動模式。
blocks.en: In-facility flow management: GMP regulations require strict control of the flow of personnel, materials, waste and samples to prevent cross-contamination. This is not only a matter of operating procedures but also of architectural design: corridors, door locations and gowning room arrangements must all support the correct flow patterns.

blocks.zh: 主要流動類型（六大流）：
blocks.en: Main flow types (the six flows):

blocks.zh: 人員流（Personnel Flow）：不同更衣級別需要不同的更衣通道
blocks.en: Personnel flow: different gowning levels need different gowning routes

blocks.zh: 物料流（Material Flow）：從上游到下游的單向流動
blocks.en: Material flow: one-way flow from upstream to downstream

blocks.zh: 緩衝液/培養基流（Buffer/Media Flow）
blocks.en: Buffer/media flow

blocks.zh: 設備維護流（Equipment Maintenance Flow）
blocks.en: Equipment maintenance flow

blocks.zh: 廢棄物流（Waste Flow）
blocks.en: Waste flow

blocks.zh: 樣品流（Sample Flow）
blocks.en: Sample flow

blocks.zh: 「主菌種/細胞庫（Master Seed/Cell Bank）應放置在靠近使用位置」這個看似小事的要求，實際上涉及重大的商業和生物安全風險。細胞庫是整個生產的核心資產，不必要的搬運會增加污染和遺失風險。在設計階段就將細胞庫位置靠近接種工作站，是降低操作風險的重要設計決策。
blocks.en: The requirement that the master seed/cell bank be located close to the point of use looks minor, but it involves major commercial and biosafety risk. The cell bank is the core asset of the whole production chain, and unnecessary handling increases the risk of contamination and loss. Placing the cell bank near the inoculation workstation at the design stage is an important design decision for reducing operational risk.

blocks.zh: 廠內流動管理就像醫院的「清潔區、污染區、半污染區」分區管理——手術室護士不會從污染走廊走進手術室，同樣地，生物製藥廠的操作人員在不同清潔等級區域之間也需要有明確的更衣換裝流程，而這些流程必須在建築設計階段就用空間布局來「強制執行」。
blocks.en: In-facility flow management is like the clean, contaminated and semi-contaminated zoning of a hospital: a surgical nurse never walks into the operating theatre through the contaminated corridor. In the same way, operators in a biopharmaceutical facility need a clear gowning and changing procedure between areas of different cleanliness, and these procedures must be "enforced" by the spatial layout at the architectural design stage.

blocks.zh: 在生物製藥廠房中，人員流動（Personnel Flow）需要考慮哪些不同的換裝路徑？為何不同等級的更衣不能共用同一條通道？
blocks.en: In a biopharmaceutical facility, which different gowning routes must be considered for personnel flow? Why can gowning for different grades not share the same route?

blocks.zh: CIP（就地清洗）管路的走向如何影響廠房的整體物料流規劃？
blocks.en: How does the routing of CIP (clean-in-place) piping affect the overall material flow planning of the facility?

blocks.zh: 7.3 Placing the Facility on the Site — 廠址選擇與廠區規劃
blocks.en: 7.3 Placing the Facility on the Site

blocks.zh: 總體規劃（Masterplanning）：Masterplanning是對整個廠區現在和未來需求的全面考量。它不只是今天的廠房配置，更是一份「廠區發展藍圖」——預留未來擴建空間、規劃公用設施管廊、考慮不同建築物之間的邏輯連結。
blocks.en: Masterplanning: Masterplanning is a comprehensive look at the present and future needs of the whole site. It is more than the layout of today's building; it is a "site development blueprint" that reserves space for future expansion, plans utility corridors, and considers the logical links between buildings.

blocks.zh: 連續製程對廠房規模的影響：現代生物製藥趨勢是從批次製程（Batch Process）轉向連續製程（Continuous Process）。連續製程可大幅縮小設備尺寸，意味著同樣產能的廠房可以更小。但這也可能造成上下游設備規模不匹配，需要在Masterplanning階段就考慮到。
blocks.en: Impact of continuous processing on facility size: The modern trend in biopharmaceuticals is a move from batch to continuous processing. Continuous processing can greatly reduce equipment size, which means a facility of the same capacity can be smaller. However, it may also cause a scale mismatch between upstream and downstream equipment, which must be considered at the masterplanning stage.

blocks.zh:
生物安全（Bio Security）的廠址考量：生物製藥廠房處理的是活的生物材料（微生物、病毒等），廠址選擇必須考慮：
1. 周邊環境污染源（工業廢氣、農業粉塵）
2. 生物材料意外洩漏對當地環境的影響
3. 政治穩定性（涉及高價值生物材料的安全）
這些考量在一般建築設計中幾乎不存在，是生物製藥廠房的特殊挑戰。
blocks.en:
Site considerations for biosecurity: Biopharmaceutical facilities handle living biological materials (microorganisms, viruses and so on), so site selection must consider:
1. Surrounding sources of contamination (industrial emissions, agricultural dust)
2. The impact on the local environment of accidental release of biological material
3. Political stability (security of high-value biological materials)
These considerations barely arise in ordinary building design and are special challenges for biopharmaceutical facilities.

blocks.zh: Masterplanning就像城市規劃——一個好的城市不只考慮今天的建設，還要預留未來道路、捷運、公園的空間。生物製藥廠區也一樣：初期建廠時就要規劃好未來10-20年可能的擴建位置，否則等到需要擴廠時才發現沒有空地，代價將非常高昂。
blocks.en: Masterplanning is like city planning: a good city considers not only today's construction but also leaves room for future roads, metro lines and parks. A biopharmaceutical site is the same: when the first facility is built, the likely expansion locations for the next 10-20 years should already be planned. Otherwise, when expansion is needed and no land is available, the cost is very high.

blocks.zh: 連續製程（Continuous Process）的導入，如何影響生物製藥廠房的空間規劃？請從上游和下游兩個角度分析。
blocks.en: How does the introduction of continuous processing affect the space planning of a biopharmaceutical facility? Analyze from both the upstream and downstream perspectives.

blocks.zh: 為什麼生物製藥廠房在廠址選擇時需要特別考慮「生物安全」因素？請舉出兩個具體的風險場景。
blocks.en: Why must biopharmaceutical facility site selection give special consideration to biosecurity? Give two specific risk scenarios.

blocks.zh: 7.3.2 Facility Concepts: Large / Small / Greenfield / Brownfield — 大型/小型廠房；全新/改建廠址
blocks.en: 7.3.2 Facility Concepts: Large / Small / Greenfield / Brownfield

blocks.zh: Greenfield（全新廠址）：在空地上全新建設，設計自由度最高，但初始投資最大，且無現有基礎設施可用。
blocks.en: Greenfield: New construction on an empty site. It gives the greatest design freedom, but the highest initial investment, and there is no existing infrastructure to use.

blocks.zh: Brownfield（改建廠址）：在已有建築或廠區基礎上改建，可利用現有設施降低成本，但受現有結構限制，可能有隱藏問題（如地基不足、配管老舊）。
blocks.en: Brownfield: Conversion based on an existing building or site. Existing facilities can be reused to reduce cost, but the design is constrained by the existing structure and there may be hidden problems (such as inadequate foundations or aging piping).

blocks.zh: Process Pods（製程艙）：可獨立運作的小型自包含製程模組，可在廠內作為「插拔式」單元使用，也可部署到偏遠地區（如發展中國家的醫療緊急需求）。這是生物製藥去中心化製造（Decentralized Manufacturing）的雛形。
blocks.en: Process Pods: Small, self-contained process modules that can operate independently. They can be used within a facility as "plug-in" units, or deployed to remote areas (for example, for urgent medical needs in developing countries). They are an early form of decentralized manufacturing in biopharmaceuticals.

blocks.zh: Brownfield改建就像在老房子裡重新裝潢：你省去了打地基的費用，但可能發現牆壁裡有老舊水管、地板承重不足、或是不符合現行法規的電路。有時候「改建成本」反而比「全新建設」更高，這就是為什麼必須在改建前做詳細的盡職調查（Due Diligence）。
blocks.en: A brownfield conversion is like renovating an old house: you save the cost of laying foundations, but you may find old pipes inside the walls, floors that cannot carry the load, or wiring that does not meet current codes. Sometimes the conversion costs more than new construction, which is why detailed due diligence must be done before conversion.

blocks.zh: HVAC進氣口的位置是生物製藥廠址選擇的關鍵！若主進氣口（HVAC Intake）靠近鄰近廠房的廢氣排放口，或靠近昆蟲繁殖地（水塘）、樹木（楊樹飛絮），將造成持續性的過濾堵塞問題，嚴重影響潔淨室等級和維運成本。這些「現場問題（Pre-existing Site Issues）」在廠址評估階段必須逐一排查，絕不能等到施工後才發現。
blocks.en: The location of the HVAC intake is critical in biopharmaceutical site selection! If the main HVAC intake is near the exhaust outlet of a neighboring facility, or near insect breeding sites (ponds) or trees (such as poplars shedding fluff), it will cause persistent filter clogging and seriously affect cleanroom classification and operating costs. These pre-existing site issues must be checked one by one during site evaluation, and must never be left until after construction.

blocks.zh: 改建廠房評估清單 Brownfield Assessment Checklist
blocks.en: Brownfield Assessment Checklist

blocks.zh:
改建前必須評估的項目：
1. 結構柱距（Column Spacing）
   → 柱距過密 = 樓板設計荷重過高 = 可能不敷使用
   → 或：缺乏設備重新配置的彈性

2. 樓板荷重（Floor Loading）
   → 大型色層管柱（Chromatography Column）的腳支撐點荷重
   → 大型緩衝液袋（Buffer Bag）的面荷重

3. 現有公用設施（Utilities）評估
   → 過大（Oversized）→ 無法「降噸」以符合節能需求
   → 過小（Undersized）→ 無法滿足新製程需求

4. 隔熱材料（Insulation）
   → 升級至現行法規可能需要整個外牆重新包覆
   → 成本可能高於全新建設

5. 現有許可（Pre-existing Permits）
   → 改建可能觸發全面升級至最新建築法規的要求
blocks.en:
Items to assess before conversion:
1. Structural column spacing
   → Columns too close together = high floor design loads = may be inadequate
   → Or: lack of flexibility to reconfigure equipment

2. Floor loading
   → Point loads from the feet of large chromatography columns
   → Area loads from large buffer bags

3. Assessment of existing utilities
   → Oversized → cannot be "turned down" to meet energy-saving needs
   → Undersized → cannot meet the needs of the new process

4. Insulation
   → Upgrading to current codes may require re-cladding the entire external wall
   → Cost may exceed that of new construction

5. Pre-existing permits
   → Conversion may trigger a requirement to upgrade fully to the latest building codes

blocks.zh: 您的公司考慮收購一座舊製藥廠進行生物製藥改建。您會優先評估哪五個方面的「隱藏風險」？
blocks.en: Your company is considering acquiring an old pharmaceutical plant for biopharmaceutical conversion. Which five areas of "hidden risk" would you assess first?

blocks.zh: Process Pods（製程艙）在CDMO的商業模式中有何潛在應用？請從客戶服務和產能彈性兩個角度思考。
blocks.en: What potential applications do Process Pods have in a CDMO business model? Consider both customer service and capacity flexibility.

blocks.zh: 7.4 Envelope/Building Shell Design and Visual Design Influences — 建築外殼設計與視覺設計影響
blocks.en: 7.4 Envelope/Building Shell Design and Visual Design Influences

blocks.zh: 建築外殼（Building Envelope / Building Shell）：指廠房的外牆、屋頂、基礎——即將室內與室外環境分隔的整個外部結構。對於生物製藥廠房，建築外殼除了提供基本的遮風擋雨功能外，還需要：
blocks.en: Building envelope / building shell: The external walls, roof and foundations, that is, the whole external structure separating the indoor and outdoor environments. For a biopharmaceutical facility, in addition to basic weather protection, the building envelope must also:

blocks.zh: 支持潔淨室的氣壓和溫濕度控制
blocks.en: Support cleanroom pressure and temperature/humidity control

blocks.zh: 最小化熱橋（Thermal Bridges）以減少結露
blocks.en: Minimize thermal bridges to reduce condensation

blocks.zh: 正確配置HVAC進排氣口位置
blocks.en: Position HVAC intakes and exhausts correctly

blocks.zh: 考慮30年以上的耐久性和維護性
blocks.en: Allow for durability and maintainability over 30 years or more

blocks.zh: Fallow/Swing Space（預留空間）：在廠房初建時刻意留出的未開發空間，供未來擴建使用。預留空間雖然短期看起來「浪費」，但長期來看是非常划算的投資。
blocks.en: Fallow/swing space: Undeveloped space deliberately left when the facility is first built, for future expansion. Although fallow space looks "wasteful" in the short term, it is a very worthwhile investment in the long term.

blocks.zh: 模組化設計決策必須在最前期做出！一旦開始詳細設計，模組尺寸就基本固定了。如果到了施工階段才決定改用模組化，不但無法享受成本優勢，反而可能因為設計改動付出更大代價。此外，模組從製造工廠到安裝現場的運輸方式（公路/海運/空運）也必須提前規劃——因為台灣的部分山路或港口可能對超大模組有限制。
blocks.en: The decision on modular design must be made at the very start! Once detailed design begins, module dimensions are essentially fixed. If the decision to use modular construction is made only at the construction stage, not only is the cost advantage lost, but design changes may even cost more. In addition, the mode of transport of modules from the factory to the site (road, sea or air) must be planned in advance, because some mountain roads or ports in Taiwan may restrict oversized modules.

blocks.zh: 建築外殼設計就像選擇車的外殼：不只看好不好看，還要考慮當地氣候（台灣多雨→防水性能）、長期維護成本（容不容易修）、30年後是否仍功能完好。一個漂亮但難以維護的建築外殼，長期TCO（總擁有成本）反而更高。
blocks.en: Designing the building envelope is like choosing a car body: look not only at appearance but also at the local climate (rainy Taiwan means waterproofing performance), long-term maintenance cost (is it easy to repair), and whether it will still function well after 30 years. A beautiful but hard-to-maintain envelope will have a higher long-term TCO (total cost of ownership).

blocks.zh: 在台灣建設生物製藥廠房時，建築外殼設計需特別注意：颱風和梅雨季帶來的大量降雨（考慮平屋頂vs坡屋頂的選擇）、高溫高濕對外牆隔熱的需求、以及地震（抗震設計）。這些因素都會影響建築外殼的設計規格，並在初期增加成本，但長期運作中可大幅降低維護費用。
blocks.en: When building a biopharmaceutical facility in Taiwan, the envelope design needs particular attention to heavy rainfall from typhoons and the plum rain season (consider flat vs pitched roofs), the need for external wall insulation in high heat and humidity, and earthquakes (seismic design). These factors all affect the envelope design specification and increase cost at the outset, but they can greatly reduce maintenance expense over long-term operation.

blocks.zh: 模組化設計在運輸階段可能遇到哪些限制？這些限制如何影響模組的最大尺寸規格？
blocks.en: What limitations may modular design meet at the transport stage? How do these limitations affect the maximum module size specification?

blocks.zh: 「模組對模組的連接（Module-to-Module Interconnection）」在生物製藥廠房中有哪些特殊要求？為什麼管道連接空間特別重要？
blocks.en: What special requirements apply to module-to-module interconnection in biopharmaceutical facilities? Why is space for piping connections especially important?

blocks.zh: 7.5 Construction Issues — 施工相關議題
blocks.en: 7.5 Construction Issues

blocks.zh: 「生物製造製程的壽命往往短於廠房壽命」：一個生物製藥製程可能只使用廠房5年，但廠房本身設計壽命是30年以上。這意味著廠房必須在設計時就考慮未來的多種用途，不能只為當前製程量身訂做。
blocks.en: "The life of a biomanufacturing process is often shorter than the life of the facility": A biopharmaceutical process may use a facility for only 5 years, while the facility itself is designed for a life of 30 years or more. This means the facility must be designed from the start for multiple future uses, and not tailored only to the current process.

blocks.zh: 樓板（Floor Slab）設計的前瞻性：在初期就將樓板設計為能承受多種荷載，雖然增加了少許初始成本，但可以省去日後每次重新配置設備時的專項基礎工程費用。
blocks.en: Forward-looking floor slab design: Designing the floor slab at the outset to carry a variety of loads adds a little initial cost, but saves the cost of special foundation work each time equipment is reconfigured later.

blocks.zh: 可移動牆板和地板段（Removable Walls / Floor Sections）：大型設備（如生物反應器）在未來維護或更換時，可能需要從廠房外搬入。預先設計好「設備進出路徑」（包括可拆卸的牆段），可大幅降低未來翻修成本。
blocks.en: Removable walls / floor sections: Large equipment (such as bioreactors) may need to be brought in from outside the building when it is maintained or replaced in future. Designing the equipment access route in advance (including removable wall sections) can greatly reduce future refurbishment costs.

blocks.zh: 本節最重要的洞察：施工時多花一點點，未來省很多。例如：樓板加厚以支持更大荷重，初期多花5%，但可能在未來10年內省下數百萬元的專項基礎工程費用。這種前瞻性的設計思維，是優秀的生物製藥廠房工程師必備的素養。
blocks.en: The most important insight of this section: spending a little more during construction saves a lot in future. For example, thickening the floor slab to support greater loads may cost 5% more at the outset, but could save millions in special foundation work over the next 10 years. This kind of forward-looking design thinking is an essential quality in a good biopharmaceutical facility engineer.

blocks.zh: 「預留公用設施擴充空間（Fallow Space for Utility Expansion）」就像蓋房子時預先配置額外的電管和水管接頭——不用立即使用，但當未來要新增冷氣或洗碗機時，不需要重新破壁重拉管線。在生物製藥廠房中，「多預留一根管道槽（Pipe Chase）」的成本遠低於日後打通牆壁增加的費用。
blocks.en: Providing fallow space for utility expansion is like installing extra conduit and water pipe connections when building a house: you do not use them immediately, but when you later add air conditioning or a dishwasher you do not have to break open the walls and re-run the lines. In a biopharmaceutical facility, the cost of "one more pipe chase" is far lower than the cost of breaking through walls later.

blocks.zh: 為什麼「Transfer Deck（轉移層）」或「穿樓板懸掛槽（Suspended Through-Floor Vessel）」需要特別的結構設計？振動問題如何影響生產？
blocks.en: Why do the "transfer deck" or the "suspended through-floor vessel" require special structural design? How do vibration problems affect production?

blocks.zh: 如果您是工程負責人，您會如何說服財務團隊批准「多花初期成本以換取未來彈性」的預算申請？
blocks.en: If you were the engineering lead, how would you persuade the finance team to approve a budget request that spends more up front in exchange for future flexibility?

blocks.zh: 7.5.1 Impact of Structure on Design — 結構設計對廠房設計的影響
blocks.en: 7.5.1 Impact of Structure on Design

blocks.zh: 結構跨距（Structural Span）對廠房彈性的影響：結構柱之間的距離越大，樓板中間越少有柱子阻礙，設備配置就越靈活。30年前商業建築的跨距是6m×6m，現在生物製藥廠房可達30-40m的超大跨距。雖然大跨距的鋼結構初始成本較高，但換來的是無限的設備重新配置彈性。
blocks.en: Effect of structural span on facility flexibility: The greater the distance between structural columns, the fewer columns obstruct the floor and the more flexible the equipment layout. Thirty years ago a commercial building span was 6 m × 6 m; today biopharmaceutical facilities can reach very large spans of 30-40 m. A long-span steel structure costs more initially, but it buys unlimited flexibility to reconfigure equipment.

blocks.zh: 舞廳概念（Dancefloor / Ballroom Concept）：大空間、長跨距的廠房設計，就像一個大舞廳——中間沒有柱子，可以隨時重新排列設備，且天花板夠高可走維修路徑。這特別適合單層或低層的生物製藥製造廠房。
blocks.en: Dancefloor / ballroom concept: A facility design with large spaces and long spans, like a big ballroom: there are no columns in the middle, equipment can be rearranged at any time, and the ceiling is high enough to allow maintenance routes. This is particularly suitable for single-story or low-rise biopharmaceutical manufacturing facilities.

blocks.zh: 18,000 L Kill Tank 的案例教訓：這個真實案例說明了「晚期設計決策的代價」——一個18,000公升的殺菌槽（Kill Tank），因為在設計後期才決定加入，導致結構工程師必須在2週內設計特殊承重框架，同時還需要選一個恰好能通過樓梯口和柱位的槽體。這種情況完全可以通過早期確認製程需求來避免。生物製藥廠房的「隱藏大型設備」（如Kill Tank、大型緩衝液槽）必須在概念設計階段就列出清單。
blocks.en: Lessons from the 18,000 L kill tank case: This real case illustrates the cost of late design decisions. An 18,000 L kill tank was added late in the design, so the structural engineer had to design a special load-bearing frame within 2 weeks, and a tank also had to be found that would just pass through the stairwell and column positions. This could have been avoided entirely by confirming the process requirements early. The "hidden large equipment" of a biopharmaceutical facility (such as kill tanks and large buffer tanks) must be listed at the conceptual design stage.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室中的結構伸縮縫（Movement Joints）：普通建築需要伸縮縫來應對熱脹冷縮，但潔淨室的伸縮縫會破壞密封性，造成微粒和微生物的潛在污染點。因此潔淨室應盡量避免結構伸縮縫，或將其設置在可以有效密封的位置。
blocks.en: Movement joints in cleanrooms: Ordinary buildings need movement joints to accommodate thermal expansion and contraction, but a movement joint in a cleanroom breaks the seal and becomes a potential contamination point for particles and microorganisms. Cleanrooms should therefore avoid structural movement joints as far as possible, or place them where they can be effectively sealed.

blocks.zh: 結構跨距的演進 Structural Span Evolution
blocks.en: Structural Span Evolution

blocks.zh:
一般建築結構跨距的演進：
30年前（1990年代）：  6m × 6m  （20ft × 20ft）
現在（2010年代）：    7.5m × 7.5m  （25ft × 25ft）
                    9m-10m  （30-35ft）
先進生物製藥廠：      30m-40m  （100-130ft）

結構跨距越大 → 設備配置越靈活 → 初始鋼材成本越高
但：未來重新配置的成本 → 大幅降低

大型生物反應器高度需求：
10,000L 生物反應器 → 約需 4-6m 淨高
20,000L 生物反應器 → 可能需要 6-8m 淨高（含設備頂部操作空間）
→ 樓高設計必須提前確認最大設備尺寸！
blocks.en:
Evolution of structural spans in general buildings:
30 years ago (1990s):  6 m × 6 m  (20 ft × 20 ft)
Now (2010s):           7.5 m × 7.5 m  (25 ft × 25 ft)
                       9 m-10 m  (30-35 ft)
Advanced biopharmaceutical plants:  30 m-40 m  (100-130 ft)

Longer structural span → more flexible equipment layout → higher initial steel cost
But: future reconfiguration cost → greatly reduced

Height requirements for large bioreactors:
10,000 L bioreactor → about 4-6 m clear height
20,000 L bioreactor → may need 6-8 m clear height (including operating space above the equipment)
→ Floor height design must confirm the largest equipment size early!

blocks.zh: 「舞廳概念（Ballroom Concept）」廠房就像一個大型倉庫式量販店（如家樂福）：沒有中間柱子、挑高天花板、任何區域都可以重新配置。相比之下，傳統小跨距廠房就像老式住宅：到處是承重柱，要改格局非常困難。生物製藥製程的設備不斷更新換代，「舞廳概念」讓廠房能夠跟上製程演進的腳步。
blocks.en: A "ballroom concept" facility is like a big warehouse-style hypermarket (such as Carrefour): no central columns, a high ceiling, and any area can be reconfigured. By contrast, a traditional short-span facility is like an old house: load-bearing columns everywhere and a layout that is very hard to change. Biopharmaceutical process equipment is constantly updated and replaced, and the ballroom concept lets the facility keep pace with process evolution.

blocks.zh: 為什麼生物製藥廠房需要比一般商業建築更大的結構跨距？請從設備尺寸和未來彈性兩個角度分析。
blocks.en: Why do biopharmaceutical facilities need larger structural spans than ordinary commercial buildings? Analyze from the perspectives of equipment size and future flexibility.

blocks.zh: 潔淨室地板的接縫（Floor Joints）設計為何如此重要？如果接縫位置設計不當，可能造成哪些GMP問題？
blocks.en: Why is the design of cleanroom floor joints so important? If joint locations are poorly designed, what GMP problems may result?

blocks.zh: 7.5.2 Seismic Considerations — 抗震設計
blocks.en: 7.5.2 Seismic Considerations

blocks.zh: 生物製藥廠房抗震設計的特殊性：一般建築的抗震設計只關注建築結構本身（不倒塌即可），但生物製藥廠房還需要考慮：
blocks.en: Special features of seismic design for biopharmaceutical facilities: Seismic design of ordinary buildings considers only the building structure itself (it need only not collapse), but a biopharmaceutical facility must also consider:

blocks.zh: 大型液態槽（Buffer Tank、Bioreactor）在地震中的液態晃動荷重（Sloshing Loads）
blocks.en: Sloshing loads from large liquid tanks (buffer tanks, bioreactors) during an earthquake

blocks.zh: 精密設備（天秤、質量流量計）的抗震固定
blocks.en: Seismic anchoring of precision equipment (balances, mass flow meters)

blocks.zh: 公用設施管路（純水、WFI、蒸汽）的抗震支撐——標準建築法規通常不涵蓋此項目
blocks.en: Seismic support of utility piping (purified water, WFI, steam), which standard building codes usually do not cover

blocks.zh: 地震後快速重啟的能力（Rapid Restart）
blocks.en: The ability to restart rapidly after an earthquake

blocks.zh: 台灣位於地震高風險區域，是亞太地區地震最頻繁的地區之一。台灣的生物製藥廠房在設計時必須特別重視：公用設施管路（WFI、蒸汽、氮氣管路）的抗震支撐設計；大型槽體的錨定設計；以及建立地震後的快速復工標準作業程序（SOP）。一旦地震造成停產，其商業損失遠超結構修復費用。
blocks.en: Taiwan lies in a high-seismic-risk zone and is one of the most earthquake-prone regions in Asia-Pacific. Biopharmaceutical facilities in Taiwan must pay particular attention in design to the seismic support of utility piping (WFI, steam, nitrogen lines), the anchoring of large tanks, and establishing a standard operating procedure (SOP) for rapid restart after an earthquake. Once an earthquake halts production, the commercial loss far exceeds the cost of structural repair.

blocks.zh: 為什麼標準建築抗震法規「不足以」保護生物製藥廠房？需要額外考慮哪些因素？
blocks.en: Why are standard seismic building codes "not enough" to protect a biopharmaceutical facility? What additional factors need to be considered?

blocks.zh: 地震後「快速重啟（Rapid Restart）」能力對CDMO的商業價值是什麼？如何在設計階段實現這一目標？
blocks.en: What is the commercial value of rapid restart capability after an earthquake for a CDMO? How can this be achieved at the design stage?

blocks.zh: 7.5.3–7.5.4 Modular Build & Structural Spans — 模組化建設與結構跨距
blocks.en: 7.5.3-7.5.4 Modular Build & Structural Spans

blocks.zh: 靜態荷重 vs 動態荷重（Static vs Active Loads）：
blocks.en: Static vs active loads:

blocks.zh: 靜態荷重（Static Loads）：固定不動的大型槽體（如穿樓板的緩衝液槽、培養基槽）的重量，需要在結構上設計專門的支撐點，且可能需要特殊地基處理。
blocks.en: Static loads: The weight of large fixed tanks (such as through-floor buffer tanks and media tanks). They need dedicated support points in the structure and may require special foundation treatment.

blocks.zh: 動態/活動荷重（Active Loads）：可移動的大型中間散裝容器（IBC, Intermediate Bulk Container），例如2噸重的IBC桶，在廠內以叉車或起重機移動時，會在不同位置產生動態荷重，樓板設計必須考慮這些荷重可能出現的所有區域。
blocks.en: Active loads: Movable large intermediate bulk containers (IBCs), for example a 2-tonne IBC. When moved around the facility by forklift or crane, they create dynamic loads at different locations, and the floor design must allow for every area where these loads may occur.

blocks.zh: 製程模組（Process Modules）通常不能自支撐（not self-supporting），必須設置在支撐甲板（Deck）或整合式框架中。這意味著在設計模組化廠房時，主體建築結構和模組結構必須協同設計，不能分開進行，否則可能出現結構不匹配的問題。
blocks.en: Process modules are usually not self-supporting and must be placed on a support deck or in an integrated frame. This means that in a modular facility, the main building structure and the module structure must be designed together and not separately, otherwise a structural mismatch may occur.

blocks.zh: 2噸重的IBC容器在廠內移動時，為何對樓板設計的挑戰大於一個固定放置的2噸槽體？
blocks.en: Why is a 2-tonne IBC moving around the facility a greater challenge for floor design than a 2-tonne tank in a fixed position?

blocks.zh: 製程模組（Process Module）「不能自支撐」的特性，對廠房主體建築設計有何影響？
blocks.en: How does the fact that a process module is "not self-supporting" affect the design of the main building?

blocks.zh: 7.6 Permitting, Code, and Insurance Issues — 許可、法規與保險議題
blocks.en: 7.6 Permitting, Code, and Insurance Issues

blocks.zh: 三個關鍵監管/保險概念：
blocks.en: Three key regulatory/insurance concepts:

blocks.zh: 1. IBC（International Building Code）：美國建築法規，不適用所有國家，各地有自己的建築法規。重要的是：許多國家的法規比IBC更嚴格。
blocks.en: 1. IBC (International Building Code): A US building code that does not apply in every country, as each jurisdiction has its own building codes. Importantly, many countries' codes are stricter than the IBC.

blocks.zh: 2. 最大可預見損失（Maximum Foreseeable Loss, MFL）：保險公司評估的最壞情況損失金額。MFL要求可能迫使設計增加額外的防火/防爆隔間，這可能與設計師希望的「開放彈性空間」相衝突。
blocks.en: 2. Maximum Foreseeable Loss (MFL): The worst-case loss amount assessed by the insurer. MFL requirements may force the design to add extra fire/explosion compartments, which may conflict with the open, flexible space the designer wants.

blocks.zh: 3. 圍堰（Bunding）：在設備或區域周圍設置的低矮隔堰，用於收集消防水、洩漏液體，防止生物性或化學性污染物進入污水系統。對於生物製藥廠房，消防水必須在排放前經過生物安全評估。
blocks.en: 3. Bunding: Low containment walls placed around equipment or areas to collect fire-fighting water and spilled liquids, preventing biological or chemical contaminants from entering the sewer. For a biopharmaceutical facility, fire-fighting water must undergo a biosafety assessment before discharge.

blocks.zh: 保險要求往往比法規更嚴格！這是ISPE文件的重要提醒。建築師通常只確保符合建築法規，但保險公司（特別是針對高價值生物製藥產品的專業保險）可能提出更嚴格的MFL要求，包括防火隔間、自動滅火系統規格、以及消防水收集系統。這些要求應在設計初期就與保險公司討論，否則後期改動代價極高。
blocks.en: Insurance requirements are often stricter than regulations! This is an important reminder in the ISPE document. Architects usually ensure only compliance with building codes, but insurers (especially specialist insurers of high-value biopharmaceutical products) may impose stricter MFL requirements, including fire compartments, automatic sprinkler system specifications and fire-water collection systems. These requirements should be discussed with the insurer at the start of design, otherwise late changes are extremely costly.

blocks.zh: 生物性廢水的特殊處理：與普通化學品不同，生物製藥廠房的消防水可能含有生物活性物質（如活病毒、重組蛋白），在排放前必須進行分析測試，確認無生物安全風險。這是建築設計中必須為此預留的物理空間（地下室/儲槽）。
blocks.en: Special handling of biological effluent: Unlike ordinary chemicals, fire-fighting water in a biopharmaceutical facility may contain biologically active material (such as live virus or recombinant protein) and must be analyzed and tested before discharge to confirm there is no biosafety risk. The physical space for this (basement or storage tanks) must be reserved in the architectural design.

blocks.zh: 保險公司的MFL要求就像嚴格的房東——即使你的設計符合建築法規，房東可能要求額外的消防設備才願意出租。在生物製藥廠房中，「保險公司的要求」這個「房東」的標準可能遠比政府建築法規更嚴，必須在規劃初期就納入考量，否則中途被要求大幅修改，損失極大。
blocks.en: An insurer's MFL requirement is like a strict landlord: even if your design complies with building codes, the landlord may demand extra fire protection equipment before agreeing to lease. In a biopharmaceutical facility, the standard set by this "landlord" (the insurer) may be far stricter than government building codes, and must be built into planning at the outset, otherwise being forced into major changes midway causes great loss.

blocks.zh: CDMO在建設新廠時，應在概念設計階段就邀請保險公司和政府審批單位參與設計審查。這樣可以提早發現「法規要求」與「保險要求」之間的差異，並在設計中取得平衡。例如：保險公司可能要求廠房每300平方公尺就要有防火隔間，但製程設計需要開放式大空間——這個矛盾必須在初期通過協商解決，而不是在施工完成後。
blocks.en: When building a new facility, a CDMO should invite the insurer and the government approval authorities to the design review at the conceptual design stage. This reveals differences between regulatory and insurance requirements early and allows a balance to be struck in the design. For example, an insurer may require a fire compartment every 300 square meters while the process design needs large open spaces. This conflict must be resolved through negotiation at the start, not after construction is complete.

blocks.zh: 為何生物製藥廠房的消防水排放需要特別的生物安全評估？這與一般化工廠有何不同？
blocks.en: Why does the discharge of fire-fighting water from a biopharmaceutical facility need a special biosafety assessment? How does this differ from an ordinary chemical plant?

blocks.zh: 圍堰（Bunding）設計在建築空間規劃上有何影響？為什麼需要提前考慮地下儲槽（Undercroft）空間？
blocks.en: How does bunding design affect architectural space planning? Why must an undercroft for underground storage tanks be considered in advance?

blocks.zh: 7.7 Facility Design and Design Management Methodologies and Tools — 設計管理方法與工具
blocks.en: 7.7 Facility Design and Design Management Methodologies and Tools

blocks.zh: 建築資訊模型（BIM, Building Information Modeling）：BIM是一種以3D模型為核心、整合所有設計、施工、運維資訊的數位化工作方式。「從3D到8D」的維度擴展：
blocks.en: Building Information Modeling (BIM): BIM is a digital way of working centered on a 3D model that integrates all design, construction and operation and maintenance information. The dimensions expand "from 3D to 8D":

blocks.zh: 3D：三維空間模型（長×寬×高）
blocks.en: 3D: three-dimensional spatial model (length × width × height)

blocks.zh: 4D：加入時間維度（施工進度模擬）
blocks.en: 4D: adds the time dimension (construction schedule simulation)

blocks.zh: 5D：加入成本維度（造價管理）
blocks.en: 5D: adds the cost dimension (cost management)

blocks.zh: 6D：加入永續設計（能源效率）
blocks.en: 6D: adds sustainable design (energy efficiency)

blocks.zh: 7D：加入設施管理（建成後的運維資訊）
blocks.en: 7D: adds facility management (operation and maintenance information after completion)

blocks.zh: 8D：加入安全管理（施工安全模擬）
blocks.en: 8D: adds safety management (construction safety simulation)

blocks.zh: 「先建後建（Build Before You Build）」：BIM允許在實際施工前，先在電腦中「虛擬建造」整棟廠房，提前發現管道碰撞（Clash Detection）、施工順序問題等，大幅減少施工現場的變更。
blocks.en: "Build Before You Build": BIM allows the whole facility to be "virtually built" on a computer before actual construction, revealing pipe clashes (clash detection) and construction sequence problems in advance and greatly reducing changes on site.

blocks.zh: BIM就像電動遊戲中的「城市建設模擬器」——在電腦中先建一座虛擬城市，觀察道路是否順暢、水電是否夠用、人流是否合理，確認沒問題後再真正動工。生物製藥廠房有15個以上的設計專業（建築、結構、電氣、暖通、管道、儀表……），沒有BIM整合，各專業之間的衝突幾乎不可避免，發現越晚代價越高。
blocks.en: BIM is like the "city-building simulator" in a video game: you build a virtual city on the computer first, check whether the roads flow, whether water and power are sufficient and whether the movement of people makes sense, and only then start real construction. A biopharmaceutical facility involves 15 or more design disciplines (architecture, structure, electrical, HVAC, piping, instrumentation and so on). Without BIM integration, conflicts between disciplines are almost inevitable, and the later they are found, the higher the cost.

blocks.zh: 生物製藥廠房的設計複雜度遠超一般建築——可能涉及15個以上的設計專業。BIM的核心價值在於：所有專業在同一個模型中工作，當一個專業修改設計時，其他相關專業可以即時看到影響。例如：HVAC工程師修改風管路徑時，結構工程師可以立即看到是否與結構梁衝突，而不是等到施工時才發現需要改管。
blocks.en: The design complexity of a biopharmaceutical facility far exceeds that of an ordinary building, possibly involving 15 or more design disciplines. The core value of BIM is that all disciplines work in the same model, and when one discipline changes its design, the other affected disciplines can see the impact immediately. For example, when the HVAC engineer changes a duct route, the structural engineer can see at once whether it clashes with a structural beam, instead of finding out during construction that the ducting must be redone.

blocks.zh: BIM維度說明 BIM Dimensions Reference
blocks.en: BIM Dimensions Reference

blocks.zh:
BIM維度層級（From 3D to 8D）：

3D → 三維空間模型（幾何形狀與位置）
4D → + 時間（施工進度規劃與模擬）
5D → + 成本（預算管理與變更估算）
6D → + 永續性（能耗分析、綠建築評估）
7D → + 設施管理（設備資產管理、維護記錄）
8D → + 安全管理（施工安全分析）

生物製藥廠房最關鍵的BIM應用：
- 管線碰撞檢測（Clash Detection）：3D
- 施工序列驗證（Construction Sequence）：4D
- 驗證計畫整合（Commissioning Schedule）：4D
- 設備維護資訊（Equipment Maintenance Data）：7D
blocks.en:
BIM dimension levels (From 3D to 8D):

3D → three-dimensional spatial model (geometry and position)
4D → + time (construction schedule planning and simulation)
5D → + cost (budget management and change estimation)
6D → + sustainability (energy analysis, green building assessment)
7D → + facility management (equipment asset management, maintenance records)
8D → + safety management (construction safety analysis)

Most critical BIM applications for biopharmaceutical facilities:
- Pipe clash detection: 3D
- Construction sequence verification: 4D
- Integration of the commissioning schedule: 4D
- Equipment maintenance data: 7D

blocks.zh: CDMO在建設或擴建廠房時採用BIM，可以帶來以下具體效益：施工前消除管線碰撞（Clash Detection）可節省大量施工返工費用；4D施工模擬可確保在不影響現有生產的情況下規劃擴建序列（特別重要：在已運作廠房旁邊擴建時，施工粉塵和噪音必須嚴格控制）；7D設施管理模型可在廠房交付後直接用於設備維護管理，提高設施管理效率。
blocks.en: Adopting BIM when a CDMO builds or expands a facility brings these specific benefits: eliminating pipe clashes before construction (clash detection) saves a large amount of rework cost; 4D construction simulation ensures the expansion sequence can be planned without disrupting existing production (especially important when expanding next to an operating facility, where construction dust and noise must be strictly controlled); and the 7D facility management model can be used directly for equipment maintenance management after handover, improving facility management efficiency.

blocks.zh: BIM的「Clash Detection（碰撞檢測）」功能在生物製藥廠房設計中為何特別重要？請舉出兩個生物製藥廠房特有的管線衝突場景。
blocks.en: Why is BIM clash detection particularly important in biopharmaceutical facility design? Give two pipe conflict scenarios specific to biopharmaceutical facilities.

blocks.zh: 生物製藥廠房可能需要15個以上的設計專業，這些專業之間的協調挑戰是什麼？BIM如何幫助解決這些挑戰？
blocks.en: A biopharmaceutical facility may need 15 or more design disciplines. What are the coordination challenges among these disciplines, and how does BIM help solve them?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 由內而外設計（Inside-Out Design）：生物製藥廠房設計從製程需求出發，先確定設備、流程、清潔分級，再推演建築結構——這是與一般建築設計最根本的差異。
blocks.en: Inside-Out Design: Biopharmaceutical facility design starts from the process requirements, fixing equipment, flows and cleanliness classification first and then working out the building structure. This is the most fundamental difference from ordinary building design.

blocks.zh: 三大設計驅動因素：功能導向風險評估、運作經濟效率、彈性/適應性/可擴展性，三者需在整個設計週期中持續平衡。
blocks.en: Three major design drivers: function-driven risk assessment, operating economics and efficiency, and flexibility/adaptability/expandability. The three must be continuously balanced throughout the design cycle.

blocks.zh: 廠內流動管理（Flow Management）：人員、物料（上游→下游）、廢棄物、樣品六大流的設計，不只是操作程序問題，更必須通過建築空間布局來「強制執行」。
blocks.en: Flow management: The design of the six flows (personnel, materials from upstream to downstream, waste and samples) is not only a matter of operating procedures but must also be "enforced" through the spatial layout of the building.

blocks.zh: Greenfield vs Brownfield：改建廠址（Brownfield）看似省錢，但隱藏的結構、公用設施、法規升級問題可能使總成本超過新建，必須在前期進行徹底的盡職調查。
blocks.en: Greenfield vs Brownfield: A brownfield conversion looks cheaper, but hidden structural, utility and code-upgrade problems may push the total cost above that of new construction, so thorough due diligence is needed up front.

blocks.zh: 模組化設計的關鍵決策時機：模組化建設的決策必須在設計最前期（概念階段）做出，且需選定承包商參與詳細設計，才能真正享受其成本和工期優勢。
blocks.en: Timing of the modular design decision: The decision to use modular construction must be made at the very start of design (the conceptual stage), and the contractor should be selected to take part in detailed design, in order to truly gain the cost and schedule advantages.

blocks.zh: 生物製藥廠房獨特的結構挑戰：大型生物反應器的高空間需求（4-8m淨高）、大型槽體的集中荷重、超大結構跨距（30-40m）、以及潔淨室中不得有結構伸縮縫——這些是小分子藥廠不存在的特殊設計考量。
blocks.en: Unique structural challenges of biopharmaceutical facilities: the high space requirement of large bioreactors (4-8 m clear height), concentrated loads from large tanks, very large structural spans (30-40 m), and no structural movement joints in cleanrooms. These design considerations do not exist in small-molecule plants.

blocks.zh: 施工期間的前瞻性設計：樓板加強、預留公用設施空間、設置可拆卸牆板——這些初期多花的小錢，是廠房30年壽命中最划算的投資。
blocks.en: Forward-looking design during construction: strengthened floor slabs, reserved utility space and removable wall panels. The small extra spend up front is the most worthwhile investment over the 30-year life of the facility.

blocks.zh: 法規、保險雙重要求：保險公司的MFL要求往往比政府建築法規更嚴格；生物性廢水需要特殊的收集和評估設施——兩者都應在設計初期就與相關方確認。
blocks.en: Dual regulatory and insurance requirements: insurers' MFL requirements are often stricter than government building codes, and biological effluent needs special collection and assessment facilities. Both should be confirmed with the relevant parties at the start of design.

blocks.zh: BIM是現代複雜廠房設計的必備工具：15個以上設計專業的協調、「先建後建」的虛擬建造驗證、以及從施工到運維的全生命週期資訊整合，BIM讓這一切變得可能。
blocks.en: BIM is an essential tool for modern complex facility design: coordination of 15 or more design disciplines, virtual construction verification ("build before you build"), and integration of information across the whole life cycle from construction to operation and maintenance are all made possible by BIM.
